title: Recent green approaches for the synthesis of thienopyrimidine scaffolds: an overview (2007–2025)

Thienopyrimidine scaffolds represent distinctive lead compounds in drug discovery due to their biological activities. Developing eco-friendly synthetic pathways as alternatives to traditional ones helps to minimize waste and reduce pollution.
